repos.description: 🤯 LobeHub is your Chief Agent Operator, organizing your agents into 7×24 operations by hiring, scheduling, and reporting on your entire AI team.
repos.summary_zh: LobeHub 是一个面向工作与生活的终极协作空间，致力于构建人类与智能体协同进化的网络。该平台支持多智能体协作、无代码团队设计，并提供智能搜索、知识库、语音交互、插件系统等强大功能，打造下一代 AI 驱动的生产力工具生态。
repos.summary_en: LobeHub is the ultimate workspace for human-agent collaboration, enabling multi-agent teamwork, effortless agent orchestration, and co-evolution between humans and AI. It features smart search, knowledge bases, voice interaction, plugin systems, and a growing ecosystem of agent teammates designed to enhance productivity.

repos.description: Bring projects, wikis, and teams together with AI. AppFlowy is the AI collaborative workspace where you achieve more without losing control of your data. The leading open source Notion alternative.
repos.summary_zh: AppFlowy 是一款开源的 AI 协作文档工具，作为 Notion 的替代方案，支持项目、维基与团队协作。基于 Flutter 和 Rust 构建，提供跨平台桌面与移动端应用，具备数据库、看板、文档及 AI 助手功能，强调数据自主控制与隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: AppFlowy is an open-source AI-powered collaborative workspace and Notion alternative, enabling projects, wikis, and team collaboration. Built with Flutter and Rust, it offers cross-platform desktop and mobile apps with databases, kanban boards, docs, and AI assistance, prioritizing data ownership and privacy.

repos.description: Teams-first Multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code
repos.summary_zh: oh-my-claudecode 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的多智能体协同框架，采用零学习曲线理念。通过团队模式（team）实现 staged pipeline 自动化开发流程，支持 tmux CLI 工作器扩展 Codex/Gemini 能力，提供 deep-interview 需求澄清和 /ccg 混合协作技能，显著提升团队协作效率。
repos.summary_en: oh-my-claudecode is a zero-learning-curve multi-agent orchestration framework for Claude Code. It enables automated team-based development via staged pipelines, supports tmux CLI workers for Codex/Gemini integration, offers deep-interview for requirement clarification, and provides /ccg skill for mixed AI collaboration to boost team productivity.

repos.description: 本文原文由知名 Hacker Eric S. Raymond 所撰寫，教你如何正確的提出技術問題並獲得你滿意的答案。
repos.summary_zh: 本指南由知名黑客 Eric S. Raymond 撰写，系统阐述高效提问的技术沟通原则，涵盖问题筛选、论坛选择、标题撰写、代码呈现等关键技巧，帮助开发者获得精准解答，提升开源社区协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Authored by renowned hacker Eric S. Raymond, this guide systematically outlines principles for effective technical communication, covering question selection, forum choice, title writing, and code presentation to help developers obtain accurate answers and improve open-source community collaboration.

repos.summary_zh: TaskMatrix 通过连接 ChatGPT 与一系列视觉基础模型，实现聊天中发送和接收图像。其核心创新在于引入模板机制，将人类经验转化为多模型协作的预定义执行流，支持图像编辑、目标检测、语义分割等复杂视觉任务，无需额外训练即可实现跨模型协同。
repos.summary_en: TaskMatrix connects ChatGPT with visual foundation models to enable image sending/receiving during chat. It introduces a template mechanism—pre-defined execution flows that leverage human expertise to orchestrate complex multi-model tasks like image editing, object detection, and segmentation, enabling seamless collaboration without additional training.

repos.description: ShowDoc is a tool greatly applicable for an IT team to share documents online一个非常适合IT团队的在线API文档、技术文档工具
repos.summary_zh: ShowDoc 是一款专为 IT 团队设计的在线文档协作工具，支持 API 文档、数据字典和技术说明的编写与管理。采用 Markdown 编辑，提供模板插入、版本历史、权限控制等功能，支持响应式网页和离线导出，显著提升团队文档协作效率。
repos.summary_en: ShowDoc is an online documentation tool designed for IT teams to create and share API documents, data dictionaries, and technical specs. It features Markdown editing, template insertion, version history, permission management, responsive design, and offline export, enhancing team collaboration efficiency.

repos.description: 收集整理远程工作相关的资料
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库系统整理远程工作相关资源，涵盖文章、问题解答、团队案例、视频播客、工具站点等，聚焦中国受众，提供远程办公经验分享、招聘信息、协作工具推荐及行业报告，助力远程工作者获取实用信息与职业发展支持。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates comprehensive resources on remote work, including articles, Q&A, team cases, videos, podcasts, tools, and reports, primarily targeting Chinese audiences. It offers practical guidance on remote work, job opportunities, collaboration tools, and industry insights to support freelancers and remote professionals.

repos.description: A persistent service that generates mock data quickly and provids visualization view.
repos.summary_zh: Easy Mock 是一个快速生成模拟数据并提供可视化界面的持久化服务，支持团队协作、Swagger 导入、Mock.js 语法及自定义响应配置，适用于前后端分离开发中的接口模拟与测试。
repos.summary_en: Easy Mock is a persistent service that quickly generates mock data with a visualization interface, supporting team collaboration, Swagger import, Mock.js schema, and customizable responses for frontend-backend development and API testing.

repos.description: An Autonomous LLM Agent for Complex Task Solving
repos.summary_zh: XAgent 是一个开源的自主 LLM 智能体，专为复杂任务求解设计。它具备高度自主性、安全性与可扩展性，支持通过 Dispatcher、Planner 和 Actor 三大模块协同工作，结合工具服务器（ToolServer）提供的文件编辑、Python 交互环境、网页浏览和 Shell 执行等功能，实现端到端的自动化任务处理，并可与人类协作完成挑战性任务。
repos.summary_en: XAgent is an open-source autonomous LLM agent designed to solve complex tasks end-to-end. It features autonomy, safety (via Docker isolation), extensibility, and human collaboration. Powered by a modular architecture with Dispatcher, Planner, and Actor components, it leverages ToolServer tools like file editing, Python notebooks, web browsing, and shell execution to autonomously plan, execute, and refine solutions.

repos.description: Simple forum software for building great communities.
repos.summary_zh: Flarum 是一个轻量级、现代化的论坛软件，专为构建高效社区而设计。基于 PHP 开发，采用 Mithril 前端框架，具备简洁界面、快速部署和强大扩展能力，支持插件化定制，适用于各类在线讨论场景。
repos.summary_en: Flarum is a lightweight, modern forum software designed to build great online communities. Built with PHP and powered by the Mithril JavaScript framework, it offers a clean interface, fast deployment, and extensive extensibility through a robust Extension API, ideal for customizable discussion platforms.

repos.description: 多模型协作工作流引擎 — /ccg:go 一个命令，AI 自动分析意图、选择策略、编排 Codex + Gemini + Claude 协作执行
repos.summary_zh: CCG 是多模型协作开发系统，由 Claude 编排、Codex 处理后端、Gemini 负责前端，提供 28 个命令覆盖完整开发流程，支持零配置一键安装，通过 OPSX 实现规格驱动开发，确保安全性和自动化。
repos.summary_en: CCG is a multi-model collaboration development system where Claude orchestrates Codex (backend) and Gemini (frontend), offering 28 slash commands for full-stack development, zero-config setup, and spec-driven workflows via OPSX for secure, automated coding.

repos.description: 🎒 飞书  ×（GPT-4 + GPT-4V + DALL·E-3 + Whisper）=  飞一般的工作体验  🚀 语音对话、角色扮演、多话题讨论、图片创作、表格分析、文档导出 🚀
repos.summary_zh: 飞书 × OpenAI 深度集成工具，支持 GPT-4、GPT-4V、DALL·E-3 和 Whisper，提供语音对话、图片生成、表格分析、角色扮演等功能，无缝嵌入飞书生态，支持多场景 AI 工作流，提升企业协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Feishu OpenAI integrates GPT-4, GPT-4V, DALL·E-3, and Whisper into Feishu, enabling voice chat, image generation, table analysis, role-playing, and more. It enhances enterprise collaboration with AI-powered workflows, supporting private deployment, cloud functions, and Docker.

repos.description: Multi-agent AI orchestration platform for automation, workflows, and developer tools. Golutra transforms Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw into a unified agent system with parallel execution, task orchestration, long-running workflows, and AI productivity workspace.
repos.summary_zh: golutra 是一款下一代多智能体协作工作台，将现有 CLI 工具转化为统一的 AI 协作枢纽。支持无限并行执行、自动化编排和实时结果跟踪，无需迁移项目或重学命令。基于 Vue 3 + Rust 的 Tauri 桌面应用，兼容 Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等主流 AI 工具，实现‘一人+AI团队’的高效开发模式，适用于软件开发、内容创作等多种场景。
repos.summary_en: golutra is a next-generation multi-agent workspace that transforms existing CLI tools into a unified AI collaboration hub. It supports unlimited parallel execution, automated orchestration, and real-time tracking without project migration or command relearning. Built with Vue 3 + Rust as a Tauri desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux, it integrates with AI agents like Claude Code and Gemini CLI to enable efficient 'one person + an AI squad' workflows across software development and content creation.

repos.description: Visible multi-agent CLI workspace for mixing Codex, Claude, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, Cursor, Copilot, Pi, OpenCode, and other AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: CCB（Claude Codex Bridge）是一个多AI智能体协作平台，支持Claude、Codex和Gemini等模型的实时协同工作。通过项目级团队管理、命名代理通信和持久化上下文，实现零拷贝的任务委派与广播同步，适用于复杂开发流程的自动化协作场景。
repos.summary_en: CCB (Claude Codex Bridge) is a real-time multi-AI collaboration platform enabling seamless coordination between Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It features persistent context, minimal token overhead, named agent communication, and project-level team management for efficient AI-driven development workflows.

repos.summary_zh: Professor Synapse 是一个智能 AI 引导系统，通过创建和协调专家代理来协助用户达成目标。它支持通用提示词（兼容任意 LLM）和 Claude 技能两种模式，具备自学习、多代理辩论、知识库维护等高级功能，适用于复杂任务的专业化指导与自动化处理。
repos.summary_en: Professor Synapse is an intelligent AI guide that creates and orchestrates specialized expert agents to help users achieve their goals. It supports both universal prompts (compatible with any LLM) and a self-building Claude Skill, featuring pattern learning, multi-agent debates, and persistent knowledge management for targeted expertise.

repos.description: 🌊 AChat - An open-source/self-hosted/local-first AI platform, designed for enterprises and teams, perfectly combining powerful local processing capabilities with seamless remote synchronization.
repos.summary_zh: AChat 是一个开源、自托管的企业级 AI 协作平台，支持本地化处理与远程同步，提供用户管理、支付集成、内容过滤等全套功能，适用于团队和组织内部 AI 应用部署。
repos.summary_en: AChat is an open-source, self-hosted AI platform designed for enterprises and teams, combining local processing with remote synchronization. It offers user management, payment integration, and content filtering out of the box.

repos.description: Material Design 中文协同翻译 - design.1sters.com
repos.summary_zh: Material Design 中文协同翻译项目致力于将 Google 官方 Material Design 规范完整翻译为中文，覆盖动画、样式、布局等核心模块，采用 GitHub 协作模式，支持多人参与翻译与校对，最终生成网页和 PDF 文档，助力国内设计师与开发者掌握统一设计语言。
repos.summary_en: This project translates Google's Material Design specification into Chinese collaboratively, covering animation, style, layout, and more. It uses GitHub for open collaboration, enabling translators and reviewers to contribute, with final outputs published as web pages and PDFs to support designers and developers in adopting a unified design language.

repos.description: 做最好的接口管理平台
repos.summary_zh: DOClever 是一款专为中小型团队打造的商业化开源接口管理平台，完全免费并支持内网部署。它提供接口全生命周期管理、可视化调试、Mock 服务、自动化测试、团队协作及多格式导入导出等功能，支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议及多种参数类型，具备版本控制与快照能力，助力高效开发协作。
repos.summary_en: DOClever is a commercial open-source API management platform, fully free and supportable for on-premise deployment. It offers comprehensive API lifecycle management, visual debugging, Mock services, automated testing, team collaboration, and import/export in multiple formats. Supporting HTTP/HTTPS protocols and various parameter types, it features version control, snapshots, and seamless integration with Postman, Swagger, and RAP.

repos.description: LinuxDo Scripts 扩展，功能持续更新，欢迎提出新想法！已上架 Chrome Web Store 和 Firefox 商店！文档地址：https://linuxdo-scripts.zishu.me
repos.summary_zh: LinuxDo Scripts 是一款专为 LinuxDo 论坛设计的浏览器扩展，集成界面优化、AI 辅助发帖、收藏夹增强等实用功能。支持 Chrome、Firefox 等主流浏览器，提供流畅的论坛交互体验，持续更新并兼容 idcflare.com 网站。
repos.summary_en: LinuxDo Scripts is a browser extension designed to enhance the LinuxDo forum experience, featuring interface optimization, AI-assisted posting, and enhanced favorites. Compatible with Chrome, Firefox, and other browsers, it offers seamless interaction and ongoing updates.

repos.description: Real-time multi-AI collaboration: Claude, Codex & Gemini with persistent context, minimal token overhead
repos.summary_zh: CCB v6 是一款原生多智能体终端运行时，支持 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等 AI 模型的并行协作。通过持久化上下文和最小化 token 开销，实现可见的并发执行、原生通信及项目级作用域管理，适用于复杂开发场景下的多角色协同编程。
repos.summary_en: CCB v6 is a native multi-agent runtime for terminal split panes, enabling real-time collaboration across Claude, Codex, Gemini, and other AI models. It provides persistent context, minimal token overhead, visible concurrency, and project-scoped runtime with built-in agent communication and delegation.

repos.description: Real-time multi-AI collaboration: Claude, Codex & Gemini with persistent context, minimal token overhead
repos.summary_zh: Claude Code Bridge (ccb) 是一个多AI模型协作工具，支持 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等模型在分屏终端中实时协同工作。核心优势包括持久化上下文记忆、低token开销的轻量异步通信机制，以及原生集成 WezTerm/tmux 的工作流。所有交互可视化，每个模型均可控，避免单一模型偏差与认知盲区。
repos.summary_en: Claude Code Bridge (ccb) enables real-time multi-AI collaboration via a split-pane terminal, supporting models like Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It features persistent context per AI instance, minimal token usage through lightweight prompts, and seamless integration with WezTerm or tmux. Every interaction is visible and controllable, eliminating single-model bias and context limits.

repos.description: 企业级 AI 编程助手，专为 研发协作 和 研发管理 场景而设计。
repos.summary_zh: MonkeyCode 是一款企业级 AI 编程助手，专为研发协作与管理场景设计，支持私有化部署与本地大模型接入，提供 IDE 对话式编程、代码补全、安全扫描及 Git 平台机器人能力，内置企业级管理面板用于审计管控与资源统一调度，兼顾效率与代码安全。
repos.summary_en: MonkeyCode is an enterprise-grade AI programming assistant designed for R&D collaboration and management. It supports private deployment, local LLM integration, and offline usage, offering IDE-based coding, intelligent completions, security scanning, Git platform bots, and a management panel for auditing, compliance, and centralized model usage control.

repos.description: JSON-driven multi-agent  cadence-team development framework with   intelligent CLI orchestration (Gemini/Qwen/Codex),   context-first architecture, and automated workflow   execution
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Code-Workflow 是一个基于 JSON 驱动的 Multi-Agent AI 开发框架，支持智能 CLI 编排（集成 Gemini/Qwen/Codex）、上下文优先架构和自动化工作流执行。通过技能化工作流系统实现团队级协作开发，提供终端仪表盘监控、队列调度及可视化编辑器，适用于复杂 AI 项目协同场景。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Code-Workflow is a JSON-driven multi-agent development framework featuring intelligent CLI orchestration (Gemini/Qwen/Codex), context-first architecture, and automated workflow execution. It enables team-based AI development through skill-based workflows, terminal dashboard monitoring, queue scheduling, and visual workflow editing for complex collaborative projects.

repos.description: A high performance open-source forum software written in PHP. Discussions Tags based with Quora/StackOverflow style.
repos.summary_zh: Carbon-Forum 是一款高性能开源 PHP 论坛系统，采用 Quora/StackOverflow 式标签讨论机制，支持移动端适配、实时推送、异步设计和完整 SEO 优化，具备现代通知中心与草稿保存功能，适用于构建高效知识分享社区。
repos.summary_en: Carbon-Forum is a high-performance open-source PHP forum software featuring Quora/StackOverflow-style discussion tags, mobile support, real-time notifications, asynchronous architecture, and full SEO optimization, ideal for building efficient knowledge-sharing communities.

repos.description: Flarum - 优雅自由的 PHP 轻社区
repos.summary_zh: Flarum 是一款基于 PHP 和 Mithril 框架的自由开源轻量级论坛软件，以简洁、响应式设计和高度可扩展性为核心特色。它提供完整的 API 支持与模块化扩展机制，适合快速搭建现代化社区平台，采用 MIT 许可证确保完全开放。
repos.summary_en: Flarum is a free, open-source forum software built with PHP and the Mithril JavaScript framework, emphasizing simplicity, responsiveness, and extensibility. It offers a modular architecture with comprehensive APIs for customization, ideal for building modern online communities under MIT license.

repos.description: MultiAgentPPT 是一个集成了 A2A（Agent2Agent）+ MCP（Model Context Protocol）+ ADK（Agent Development Kit） 架构的智能化演示文稿生成系统，支持通过多智能体协作和流式并发机制
repos.summary_zh: MultiAgentPPT 是基于 A2A+MCP+ADK 架构的多智能体演示文稿生成系统，通过大纲生成、主题拆分、并行调研和流式汇总等智能体协作，实现高质量PPT的自动化生成，支持实时编辑与下载，具备可扩展性和本地模型适配能力。
repos.summary_en: MultiAgentPPT is a multi-agent system leveraging A2A+MCP+ADK architecture to automate PPT generation through outline creation, topic splitting, parallel research, and streaming synthesis. It supports real-time editing, high-quality content, extensibility, and local model compatibility.

repos.description: :books: 一起写Python文章，一起看Python文章 - 利用readthedocs的Python技术文章的收集和翻译。
repos.summary_zh: PyZh 是一个基于 ReadTheDocs 的 Python 技术文章翻译与收集项目，致力于汇聚优质英文技术文档并提供中文翻译。项目采用 RST 格式编写，支持多语言协作，提供 RSS 订阅和在线浏览功能，鼓励社区共同参与内容创作与翻译。
repos.summary_en: PyZh is a Python technology article translation and collection project built on ReadTheDocs, aiming to aggregate high-quality English technical articles with Chinese translations. It uses RST format, supports collaborative writing, offers RSS subscription and online reading, and encourages community contributions.

repos.description: A more beautiful and easier-to-use alternative to OpenClaw. It features a nicer Web UI, built-in IM support, a sandboxed runtime and channel-based team collaboration. Under the hood, it is powered by a Claude Code–based agent.
repos.summary_zh: Poco 是一款基于 Claude Code 的智能体平台，提供比 OpenClaw 更美观易用的替代方案。核心特性包括安全沙箱环境、多模态文件支持、原生 Claude Code 交互体验（计划模式/提问模式）、内置浏览器与 GitHub 集成、MCP/Skills 扩展能力，以及钉钉/飞书/Telegram 消息集成。采用 Next.js + FastAPI 架构，支持 Docker 一键部署和移动端访问。
repos.summary_en: Poco is a safer and more user-friendly alternative to OpenClaw, powered by a Claude Code-based agent. It features a secure sandboxed runtime, native Claude Code experience (Plan Mode, AskQuestion), built-in browser, GitHub integration, MCP/Skills extensibility, IM integrations (DingTalk/Feishu/Telegram), and multilingual support. Built with Next.js + FastAPI, deployable via Docker with mobile access.

repos.description: 腾讯会议摸鱼工具
repos.summary_zh: TMSpeech 是一款 Windows 平台的实时语音转文字工具，基于 sherpa-onnx 框架实现中文会议语音识别，支持 WASAPI 内录、实时字幕显示与历史记录保存。具备低 CPU 占用（<5%）、无边框可拖动界面、自定义外部识别器集成等功能，适用于会议转录、走神备忘等场景。
repos.summary_en: TMSpeech is a Windows-based real-time speech-to-text tool using the sherpa-onnx framework for Chinese meeting transcription. It captures system audio via WASAPI, displays live subtitles like lyrics, and saves recognition history. Features include low CPU usage (<5%), draggable UI, and support for custom external recognizers, ideal for meetings and note-taking.

repos.description: gpt team管理和自动邀请
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 的 ChatGPT Team 账号管理系统，支持管理员批量导入 AT Token、生成兑换码、自动同步团队信息及成员管理，用户通过兑换码自助加入团队。集成代理配置、Webhook 库存预警和第三方 API 自动补货，提供 Docker 一键部署与完整的前后端分离架构。
repos.summary_en: A FastAPI-based ChatGPT Team account management system enabling admins to bulk-import AT Tokens, generate redeem codes, auto-sync team data, and manage members. Users redeem codes to join teams via email. Features include proxy support, webhook inventory alerts, third-party API integration for auto-replenishment, and Docker deployment.

repos.description: 完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App | Completely free, open-source, collaborative accounting Web App
repos.summary_zh: Cent 是一款完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App，基于 GitHub 仓库实现数据同步与版本控制，无需服务器即可跨平台实时协作。支持语音记账、AI 智能分析、多币种管理、地图可视化、周期记账等高级功能，采用纯前端 PWA 架构，数据完全自持于用户私有仓库，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Cent is a completely free, open-source collaborative accounting web app that uses GitHub repositories for data synchronization and version control, enabling real-time cross-platform collaboration without servers. It supports advanced features like voice记账, AI analysis, multi-currency management, map visualization, and recurring transactions. Built as a pure frontend PWA with data stored in user-owned private repositories for full privacy and security.

repos.description: 一个基于Python和Flask的Web应用，整合了多维度股票分析能力和人工智能辅助决策功能。系统通过AKShare获取股票数据，结合技术分析、基本面分析和资金面分析，为投资者提供全方位的投资决策支持。
repos.summary_zh: 基于Python/Flask和LangGraph的智能股票分析系统，整合AKShare多源数据与13个专业AI Agent（技术、基本面、资金流、情绪等），提供100分制综合评分及情景预测。支持联网搜索问答、Human-in-the-Loop风险审批、MCP工具接口，具备财经门户式可视化界面与实时全球市场监控。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered stock analysis web application built with Python/Flask and LangGraph, integrating multi-source data via AKShare and 13 specialized AI agents (technical, fundamental, capital flow, sentiment). Features 100-point scoring, scenario forecasting, web-searchable Q&A, human-in-the-loop risk approval, MCP tool server, and real-time global market monitoring with a financial portal-style interface.

repos.description: Downloads : https://brahma-dev.github.io/synergy-stable-builds/
repos.summary_zh: Synergy 是一款开源的跨平台输入共享工具，允许用户通过一套键鼠无缝控制多台计算机。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，提供简洁的配置与编译流程，适用于多设备办公场景，强调自由使用与二次开发。
repos.summary_en: Synergy is an open-source, cross-platform tool that enables sharing a single mouse and keyboard across multiple computers. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, with straightforward configuration and build processes, ideal for multi-device productivity environments.

repos.description: 一个先进的聊天应用，演示了一种独特的对话范式：用户的查询首先由两个不同的人工智能角色进行辩论和提炼，然后才提供最终的综合答案。该项目利用 Google Gemini API 驱动一个逻辑型 AI (Cognito) 和一个怀疑型 AI (Muse)，它们协作生成更健壮、准确和经过严格审查的响应。
repos.summary_zh: Dual AI Chat 是一个基于 React 19 的先进聊天应用，创新性地引入双 AI 协作范式：逻辑型 Cognito 与创意型 Muse 通过内部辩论提炼答案，结合 Google Gemini 深度思考模型，提供更高准确性、全面性和严谨性的综合响应。
repos.summary_en: Dual AI Chat is an advanced chat application built with React 19 that introduces a novel dual-AI collaboration paradigm. It leverages two distinct AI personas—Cognito (logical) and Muse (creative)—to debate and refine responses, enhanced by Google Gemini's deep thinking capabilities for more accurate, comprehensive, and rigorously vetted answers.

repos.description: Android Client for Carbon Forum with Material Design.
repos.summary_zh: Android-Carbon-Forum 是一个基于 Material Design 的 Carbon Forum 论坛 Android 客户端，提供流畅的移动端浏览体验，支持主题查看、发帖、登录、通知推送等功能，采用模块化架构便于二次开发和定制部署。
repos.summary_en: Android-Carbon-Forum is an Android client for Carbon Forum built with Material Design, offering seamless mobile browsing, topic viewing, posting, login, and push notifications. It features a modular architecture for easy customization and deployment.

repos.description: Open-source framework to make AI agents' team collaboration as effective as human collaboration.
repos.summary_zh: L3AGI 是一个开源框架，旨在让 AI 智能体团队协作达到人类团队的高效水平。它支持构建和管理自主 AI 助手团队，具备记忆能力、多数据源集成（如 PostgreSQL、MySQL、VectorDB）和 LlamaIndex 支持，适用于复杂任务协作与自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: L3AGI is an open-source framework enabling AI agents to collaborate as effectively as human teams. It supports autonomous AI assistants with memory, multi-data source integration (PostgreSQL, MySQL, VectorDB), and LlamaIndex, ideal for complex task automation and team-based workflows.

repos.description: AI Chat / Search / Notes / Collaboration / Channels / Cloud Drive, all in one place! - Collaborative AI Platform.
repos.summary_zh: Nya AI 是一个集成 AI 聊天、网页搜索、笔记记录、文档协作、团队沟通与云端存储的一体化智能协作平台。其核心优势在于以 AI 为中心的交互设计，支持多分支对话、文件解析、MCP 扩展、多模态输入输出及实时云同步，提供接近本地应用的流畅体验。
repos.summary_en: Nya AI is an integrated collaborative platform combining AI chat, web search, note-taking, document writing, team communication, and cloud storage. Its core strength lies in AI-centric design with features like message branching, file parsing, MCP integration, multimodal I/O, and real-time cloud sync via Zero, delivering a local-first-like experience across devices.

repos.description: 🍟 This project is configured with an advanced AI collaboration workflow based on `CLAUDE.md`. It uses **Claude** as the core orchestrator, dispatches **Auggie (ACE)** for efficient context retrieval, and leverages **Codex** and **Gemini** for logical analysis, prototype generation, and code auditing—achieving a "**1+1+1>3**" collaborative effect.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目构建了一套基于CLAUDE.md的高级AI协作工作流，以Claude为核心编排器，调度Auggie进行上下文检索，并协同Codex与Gemini实现逻辑分析、原型生成和代码审计，形成1+1+1>3的多模型协同效应，适用于企业级智能开发场景。
repos.summary_en: This project implements an advanced AI collaboration workflow based on CLAUDE.md, with Claude as the orchestrator, Auggie for context retrieval, and Codex/Gemini for logic analysis, prototyping, and code auditing—achieving synergistic '1+1+1>3' multi-model collaboration for enterprise-grade development.

repos.description: Carbon Forum HTTP API Documentation.
repos.summary_zh: Carbon Forum HTTP API 文档为开发者提供完整的论坛接口规范，涵盖用户认证、帖子管理、通知系统等核心功能，支持分页浏览、安全验证码及头像上传，适用于构建第三方论坛客户端或集成自动化工具。
repos.summary_en: Carbon Forum HTTP API Documentation provides comprehensive interface specifications for forum operations, including user authentication, topic management, notifications, and avatar handling. It supports pagination, security codes, and is designed for building third-party clients or integrating automation tools.

repos.description: claudeclaw
repos.summary_zh: MateCode 是一个通过 Telegram 远程控制 Claude Code 的桥接工具，支持长期记忆、会话管理、代码高亮等功能。采用纯 Python 标准库开发，基于长轮询实现低延迟通信，所有数据本地存储保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: MateCode is a bridge tool that enables remote control of Claude Code via Telegram, featuring long-term memory, session management, and code highlighting. Built with pure Python standard libraries, it uses long polling for low-latency communication with local SQLite storage for privacy.

repos.description: 会议记录
repos.summary_zh: Meeting Mind 是一款智能会议记录与分析系统，集成实时语音识别（FunASR）、说话人分离和本地 LLM 分析能力。支持涉密模式本地处理、异步重转写、移动端适配及深色/浅色主题切换，确保数据隐私与高效协作。
repos.summary_en: Meeting Mind is an intelligent meeting transcription and analysis system combining real-time ASR (FunASR), speaker diarization, and local LLM-powered insights. It supports offline processing for sensitive data, async re-transcription, mobile responsiveness, and dark/light themes for secure and efficient meetings.

repos.description: Yet Another Pair Programming Package for Atom.
repos.summary_zh: Coeditor 是一个为 Atom 编辑器设计的实时协同编程插件，支持多用户无冲突文本编辑、语法高亮同步、文件操作同步及项目级协作感知。通过自建 WebSocket 服务器实现客户端间状态同步，适用于远程结对编程场景，需统一配置换行符以避免内容不一致。
repos.summary_en: Coeditor is a real-time collaborative programming plugin for Atom, enabling conflict-free text editing, syntax highlighting sync, file operations, and project awareness across multiple users. It relies on a custom WebSocket server for state synchronization, ideal for remote pair programming, with strict line ending consistency requirements across clients.

repos.description: 在 tmux 中管理交互式 Claude Code agent，并在 kitty 中协调不同 code agent 的可见协作与接力
repos.summary_zh: CCM Orchestra 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的控制平面，通过 tmux 实现持久化交互式代理会话管理，并利用 kitty 提供可视化协作与消息中继功能。该系统采用分层架构：tmux 层负责会话生命周期管理与工作目录隔离，kitty 层支持多代理可见协作与接力通信，形成可观测、可复用的 AI 编程协作模型。
repos.summary_en: CCM Orchestra is a control plane for managing persistent, interactive Claude Code agents in tmux while enabling visible collaboration between code agents through kitty. It features a two-layer architecture: the tmux layer maintains reusable agent sessions with worktree isolation, while the kitty layer provides human-observable coordination and message relay capabilities, forming a paired operating model for parallel AI-assisted development workflows.

repos.description: oag is a lightweight CLI for managing a Git-based AI asset registry, enabling one-command install and   update of agents, skills, and MCP configs into local environments like Claude, Codex, and OpenCode for   consistent setup and faster team collaboration.
repos.summary_zh: oag 是一个轻量级 CLI 工具，用于管理基于 Git 的 AI 资产注册中心，支持一键安装、更新代理、技能及 MCP 配置到 Claude、Codex 和 OpenCode 等本地环境，提升团队协作效率与配置一致性。
repos.summary_en: oag is a lightweight CLI tool for managing a Git-based AI asset registry, enabling one-command installation and updates of agents, skills, and MCP configs into local environments like Claude, Codex, and OpenCode for consistent setup and faster team collaboration.
